blocks.text: Hum different (alag alag) qism ki waves (lehron) se achhi tarah familiar (waqif) hain, jaise samandar mein pani ki waves aur barish ke qatron se thehre hue pani ke talab par bante gol ripples (chhoti waves). Jab koi musician guitar ka taar chhedta hai to hawa mein sound waves paida hoti hain jo hamare kaan tak pohanch kar music ka ehsas dilati hain. Suraj karoron kilometre door hai, phir bhi us ki bohat bari energy light waves ke zariye Zameen tak pohanchti hai. Is chapter mein hum different waves ka banna, phailna (propagation) aur un ke istemal parhenge.

Wave ek regular (baqaida) disturbance (khalal) ya tabdeeli hai jo energy le kar chalti hai aur source se bahar phailti hai. Misal ke taur par Suraj se Zameen tak energy light waves ki shakal mein aati hai; inhein electromagnetic waves kehte hain aur yeh vacuum (khala) mein bhi chal sakti hain. Lekin kisi medium mein energy regular aur baar baar hone wali disturbances ke zariye transfer (muntaqil) hoti hai jo medium mein chalti hain aur us ke particles (zarron) ko oopar neeche ya aage peeche (to and fro) hilati hain. Socheye ke talab ke pani mein ek pathar phenka gaya (Fig. 7.1).

items: Pathar ek disturbance (ripple) paida karta hai jo pani (medium) mein aage chalti hai.
Pani ke particles apni apni jagah par oopar neeche hote hain, aur ek dohrata hua pattern banta hai jise wave kehte hain; yeh bahar ki taraf phailti hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki thehri surface (satah) par ek nuqte se bahar phailte neele daire (rings), tirchhi nazar se.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: Safar karta khalal (ripple) (kitab ki Figure 7.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Wave ke kisi particle ka displacement (apni jagah se hatna) us ki aaram (rest) ya equilibrium position se kisi fixed (muqarrar) direction (simt) mein us ka faasla hai. Agar displacement ko y-axis par aur energy ke safar ki direction mein distance (faasle) ko x-axis par plot karein to waveform milta hai, jaisa Fig. 7.2 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab x-axis ke liye “the time in the direction of energy travel” (energy ke safar ki direction mein time) likhti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke x-axis par energy ke safar ki direction mein distance (faasla) hota hai; kitab ki apni Fig. 7.2 bhi x-axis par Distance likhti hai.

blocks.alt: Axes x' se x aur y' se y, O par milte hain; khari axis par Displacement aur pari axis par Distance. O se shuru magenta sine curve par Wave likha hai. Do crests ke darmiyan cyan do-teer Wavelength lambda; axis se crest tak cyan do-teer amplitude dikhata hai, aur axis Line of undisturbed positions hai. Axis se curve tak chhota teer Displacement.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: Wave ki graph ke zariye wazahat (kitab ki Figure 7.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Axis (Line of undisturbed positions) woh jaga hai jahan particles aaram mein hote. Kisi particle ka displacement axis se curve tak ka faasla hai; sab se zyada displacement amplitude hai (crest tak ka teer). Do consecutive (saath wale) crests ka faasla wavelength (wave ki length) λ hai.
Waves ko neeche diye gaye parameters (wave ko bayan karne wali quantities) se bayan kiya jata hai:

items: Amplitude (A): equilibrium position se wave (ya medium ke particles) ka zyada se zyada displacement.
Frequency (f): ek second mein oscillations/vibrations ya cycles (chakkaron) ki number (tadaad).
Wavelength (λ): wave par do consecutive (saath saath wale) milte julte points ka faasla jo ek hi phase mein hon.
Period (T): wave ko ek oscillation ya cycle poora karne mein lagne wala waqt. Yeh frequency ka reciprocal (ulat) hai: T = 1/f.

blocks.text: Wave daen taraf chalti hai lekin pani ke molecules sirf oopar neeche move karte (hilte) hain (khara do-teer). Is liye pani ki wave transverse hai: particles ki motion wave ki direction ke perpendicular (90° par) hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal: agar frequency 50 Hz aur wavelength 2 m ho to v = fλ = 50 × 2 = 100 m s⁻¹, aur period T = 1/f = 1/50 = 0.02 s.
Waves ki qismein
Waves ki kai shaklein hain aur har ek ki apni properties (khasusiyat) hain. Different qism ki waves ka short bayan neeche hai:
1. Mechanical Waves

In waves ko chalne ke liye physical medium (solid, liquid ya gas) chahiye. Misalein: pani ki waves (samandar, jheel ya talab ke ripples), sound waves (hawa, pani ya solids mein sunai dene wali vibrations), seismic waves (zalzale ki waves), waghaira.
2. Electromagnetic Waves

Inhein chalne ke liye medium nahi chahiye, is liye yeh vacuum mein bhi chal sakti hain. Misalein: radio waves (wireless communication), microwaves (khana pakana aur garam karna), infrared waves (IR ya heat radiation), visible light (dhoop, lamp ki roshni), ultraviolet waves (UV radiation), X-rays (medical imaging, yaani body ke andar ki tasveer), gamma rays (bohat zyada energy wali radiation), waghaira.
3. Quantum Waves
Quantum waves electrons aur photons jaise particles se judi hoti hain. Misalein: matter waves/particle waves (atoms mein electron waves) ya de-Broglie waves, photon waves (light quanta), waghaira.

blocks.title: Do you know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Waves ki yeh qismein physics, engineering aur rozmarra zindagi ke bohat se phenomena (natural events, qudrati waqiaat) samajhne ke liye zaroori hain.
4. Surface Waves
Surface waves surface (satah) ke saath ya do mediums ke interface (milne ki jagah) ke saath chalti hain. Misalein: samandar ki surface ki waves (hawa se banne wali), seismic surface waves, waghaira.
Transverse aur Longitudinal Waves

Waves ki do bari qismein hain: transverse waves aur longitudinal waves. Transverse wave woh hai jis mein particles ki vibrations wave ki energy ke chalne ki direction ke right angle (90°) par hoti hain. Longitudinal wave woh hai jis mein particles ki vibration ki direction energy ke chalne ki direction ke saath, yaani parallel (mutawazi), hoti hai.
Transverse wave aur longitudinal wave Figs. 7.3 (a aur b) mein dikhayi gayi hain.

blocks.alt: (a) Transverse waves: baen taraf haath mez par rakhe lambe spring ko pehlu ki taraf hilata hai (handle par oopar neeche teer); spring mein wave banti hai jo daen taraf Fixed end tak chalti hai, teer par Wave. (b) Longitudinal waves: haath spring ko us ki length ke rukh aage peeche karta hai (daen baen teer); dabe aur khinche hisse Fixed end tak chalte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.3: Waves ki main types (bari qismein) (kitab ki Figure 7.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein spring ke chakkar wave ki direction ke perpendicular (90° par) hilte hain: transverse wave. (b) mein chakkar wave ki direction mein hi aage peeche hilte hain, kahin qareeb qareeb (compression) aur kahin door door (rarefaction): longitudinal wave.

blocks.prompt: Longitudinal aur transverse waves mein farq bataiye (short question 7.4), aur longitudinal wave ke compressions aur rarefactions ka transverse wave ke crests aur troughs se comparison (muqabla) kijiye (constructed response 7.3).
blocks.explanation: Transverse wave mein particles energy ke safar ki direction ke perpendicular hilte hain (taar par wave, light); longitudinal wave mein us ke saath saath (hawa mein sound). Compressions, jahan particles ghane hain aur pressure (dabao) sab se zyada, crests jaisa role ada karte hain, aur rarefactions, jahan particles phaile hain aur pressure sab se kam, troughs ka; dono mein wavelength ek se agle ek jaise hisse tak ka faasla hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Wave regular disturbance hai jo source se energy le kar chalti hai; medium ke particles sirf apni jagah par hilte hain.
Parameters: amplitude A, frequency f, wavelength λ, period T = 1/f, speed v = λ/T = fλ (7.1), phase θ.
Qismein: mechanical, electromagnetic, quantum aur surface waves.
Transverse: vibration safar ki direction ke right angle par; longitudinal: vibration safar ki direction ke parallel.
